intent_record.intent_summary: Fixes runtime PM handling during system suspend/resume to ensure I2C controller availability for devices requiring access during noirq callbacks.
intent_record.what: Modified riic_i2c_suspend() to add detailed comments about runtime PM behavior, simplified error handling by returning pm_runtime_resume_and_get() directly, and added two new callbacks: riic_i2c_resume() and riic_i2c_suspend_noirq().
intent_record.how: Ensures the I2C controller remains active during system suspend/resume transitions by waking it up before runtime PM is disabled, allowing devices to access the controller during noirq callbacks when they may need it.

intent_record.intent_summary: Corrects system power management sequencing by forcing device suspend and deferring resume until after IRQs are disabled
intent_record.what: Replaced pm_runtime_put_sync with pm_runtime_force_suspend in riic_i2c_suspend, and renamed riic_i2c_resume to riic_i2c_resume_noirq
intent_record.how: Forces device suspension during system suspend bypassing runtime PM usage counters, and ensures resume logic executes after interrupts are disabled during system resume

intent_record.intent_summary: Fixes resume flow by explicitly forcing runtime PM resume before hardware initialization.
intent_record.what: Added a call to pm_runtime_force_resume(dev) with error checking inside the riic_i2c_resume function.
intent_record.how: Ensures the device is forcibly resumed at the runtime PM level before hardware initialization, preventing failures if the device was previously suspended.
